title: You don’t need a better prompt
description:
You don’t need a better prompt. You need a better Claude Codes.

One word at the end of your message tells Claude how to think, who to be, and what to cut. Skeptic, mirror, blind spots, ultrathink, each one flips a different switch.

And the tenth one lets you save your own and run it forever.

Drop “CODE” in the comments and I’ll send the full list your way 🚀
